title: Pilot: one county-ag profile explainer end-to-end (USDA NASS)
context: The M0 pilot proves the per-region decomposition pattern end-to-end before scaling to harder modules. County-ag-profiles (USDA NASS Quick Stats) is chosen as the lowest-risk starting point: US government public domain data, no PII, place/institution-level only, low methodology risk. Completing this pilot validates the shared toolkit (toolkit-002), the license gate (gate-003), the Methodology Card (methodcard-004), and the accessibility standard (a11y-005) together, before any medium-risk module is attempted. An acceptance path must exist before building begins (outreach-007).
objective: Build and deliver one county-ag profile explainer end-to-end — using the shared toolkit and passing all required gates — with confirmed adoption or a documented delivered-pending status and blocker identified.
acceptanceCriteria: Module = county-ag-profiles for one county (USDA NASS Quick Stats: US-gov public domain, no PII); county chosen according to the region rubric (regionrubric-006).
Gate-003 PASS recorded as a committed artifact (PD source; output explainer text CC-BY-4.0; no PII present in output).

Plain-language profile + small static tool built using the shared toolkit (toolkit-002); Methodology Card (methodcard-004 schema) + Sources-&-limits panel + vintage badge present; figures reproduce in CI from committed code + USDA NASS snapshot.
Accessibility pass (WCAG 2.2 AA, reading grade <= 8) signed off by the Accessibility reviewer per the a11y-005 standard.

Adopted via an informal channel (a teacher/extension office/portal agrees to use/host it) or via self-serve+external-use with the Steward's outcomes/<explainer-id>.json recorded, OR explicitly marked delivered-pending with the adoption blocker surfaced.
resources: toolkit-002, gate-003, methodcard-004, a11y-005, regionrubric-006, outreach-007, reviewers-001 (all prerequisites)
output: A complete county-ag profile explainer for one county: committed static tool + plain-language content + Methodology Card + gate artifact (PASS) + accessibility sign-off + outcomes record (adopted) or delivered-pending note with blocker.
